title: **"It's never too late to learn something new! Even at 50, I'm finally learning how to cook—because why not? Life is a journey of growth, and every day is a chance to improve.
paragraphs: **"It's never too late to learn something new! Even at 50, I'm finally learning how to cook—because why not? Life is a journey of growth, and every day is a chance to improve.
📖 "The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out." – Proverbs 18:15
So to all who think they’re ‘too old’ to start something—don’t believe that lie. God designed us to keep learning, keep growing, and keep surprising ourselves.
Now, let's just pray I don’t burn the kitchen down. 🙏😂🔥 #NeverTooLate #LearningIsAGift #BibleWisdom #CookingAt50"**
